content:
maria: Quick poll — thinking of doing a weird 7-player LAN night this Thursday. Real question: we have six wired ports at the mezz and one spare AP. Who's bringing a dock/hub that can share ethernet + power?
ken: I can bring my USB-C 7-in-1 hub (has USB-A + ethernet + PD). Not sure about passthrough charging speed. :thumbsup:
sam: bringing Steam Deck + a small USB-C dock that does ethernet + PD. It charged fine on my portable battery last week.
zoe: I only have a Switch OLED dock (full dock). Will need TV space or a capture if we want streams.
alex: I can bring a cheap gigabit switch (5 port). It'll help if multiple folks want wired.
taylor: I can bring a multi-outlet surge strip and a couple short Cat6 patch cables. Also snacks. :pizza:
maria: perfect — sounds like hub/dock coverage is OK. Two logistics Qs: 1) do we need to reserve a TV/room? 2) any controller parity concerns (PC controllers vs Joy‑Cons for party games)?
ken: For parity, we could run boxed multiplayer on PC where possible, or Jackbox (phone controllers) to avoid Bluetooth mess.
sam: If we want low-latency local play (SMash-like), we should route consoles through TVs. PS Remote Play + Capture = lag, avoid that.
zoe: TV reservation — 3rd-floor lounge is free after 6pm. I'll put a sticky sign.
alex: If people bring controllers, bring USB extenders. I've got 2 wired Xbox pads and 3 USB-Cs.
taylor: also pro tip: label chargers/cables with a bit of tape. Last time everyone grabbed the same USB‑C and we had a tiny crisis. :joy:
maria: schedule then — arrive 6:30 setup, games start 7:15, pizza ~8:30. Who's in? Reply with what you can bring (hub/dock/switch/TV/cables/snacks).
ken: in — hub + 2 patch cables
sam: in — deck + dock + 1 controller
zoe: in — switch dock + TV (60Hz OLED)
alex: in — 5-port switch + 2 extenders
taylor: in — surge strip + cables + pizza (veggie)
ops-bot: Reminder set: "LAN night — setup @ 6:30" for 2024-06-12 18:30
maria: amazing. I'll post a follow-up with a little seating map and power layout. If anyone needs to plug in >2 devices in one spot, ping me and I'll mark it on the map. :)
